$comment: The Documents module's folder structure. Kept BYTE-IDENTICAL in backend/src/config/documentCategories.json and frontend/src/app/config/documentCategories.json; backend/tests/document-categories.test.js fails if the two diverge. Documents are filed by Child -> Category -> File. Nothing is ever filed under the account that uploaded it. `rules` is evaluated in order and the FIRST match wins, so put the specific signals (a published `type`) above the loose keyword ones. `defaultFolder` is the fallback and must also appear in `folders`.

rules.$note: The Resident Comprehensive Report the Reports module files, one per resident. Matched on `type` alone, deliberately: the title carries the word "report", and the loose keyword pass would otherwise decide where it lands.

The discharge report the Phase Timeline files when a resident is discharged. Matched on `type` alone, deliberately: a loose "discharge" keyword would also claim the Pre-integration Phase's "Discharge Form", which is a required document and belongs with the admission paperwork.

The Admission Phase's X-ray is admission paperwork, filed with the court order and the case information rather than with the medical records. Matched on an exact `type` because "x-ray" is also a Medical Records keyword and the type pass runs before the keyword pass. Deliberately does not touch a document titled "X-ray Result", which carries no type and still files under Medical Records.

Sits above the Educational rule on purpose: a home-visit form is a casework record, but its title contains the word "school", so the Educational rule would claim it if it were evaluated first. This is the one place where a more specific rule has to outrank a broader one.
